outgoing.name: Bronze Age
outgoing.excerpt: Examples of Bronze Age wood-carving include trees worked into coffins from northern Germany and Denmark, and wooden folding-chairs.

outgoing.name: Copper
outgoing.excerpt: The metal used by the Egyptians for woodworking tools was originally copper and eventually, after 2000 BC bronze as ironworking was unknown until much later.

outgoing.name: Denmark
outgoing.excerpt: Examples of Bronze Age wood-carving include trees worked into coffins from northern Germany and Denmark, and wooden folding-chairs.

outgoing.name: France
outgoing.excerpt: Wooden idols from the La Tène period are known from a sanctuary at the source of the Seine in France.

outgoing.name: Iron Age
outgoing.excerpt: The site of Fellbach-Schmieden in Germany has provided fine examples of wooden animal statues from the Iron Age.
